contract: Identical parent parameters, all q, width2, complete 432/288 A1 images and same eight frozen centers. Exact uint64 bit-string deduplication across centers, nonzero connectors and spatial images; retain every multiplicity and diagonal term. No coset, cutoff, architecture, training or energy-selection change. JAX device-only plan and forward H action; independent chunked/rematerialized full A1 amplitude for score gradients.
measurements: Separate fresh CPU process per geometry. Synchronized three-repeat timing after separate lowering/compile/first call. Remeasure old projected H in same process before new end-to-end H, including rebuilding the dedup plan. Measure plan-only, cached-plan evaluation, full A1 amplitude, full real-parameter VMC covariance force on frozen parent local energies, and 1/16-proposal fixed-Sz exchange blocks including current-amplitude refresh. No gradient through local energy. Sampler blocks start from same probes/key on every repeat and are not equilibrium energy samples. Measure finite-difference force replay and identical-key old/new sampler decisions.
checks: Independent small dense H, complex amplitudes, stabilizers, repeated bonds, 36-bit keys, non-invariant H, amplitude/force derivatives, and exact detailed balance before N36. Compare all eight N36 H ratios and amplitudes to sealed parent and freshly executed old kernel. Preserve undefined nodes/nonfinite failures; no filtering. Check parameters remain unchanged. Save force and sampler endpoints/counts; no optimization or physical-energy claims.
caps: 1800s per geometry wall alarm, cumulative CPU RSS checked between stages <=8GiB (not hard mid-compile enforcement). No automatic retries, batch/architecture sweep, GPU or remote job. Report failures/negative speedups as outcomes. No production budget inferred from CPU measurements.
